2607.06540.title: Hierarchical Acoustic-Semantic Modeling: Modality Separation and Semantic Coherence for Full-Duplex SLMs
2607.06540.paper_summary: Developing seamless, high-performance, native intelligent full-duplex Spoken Language Models (SLMs) remains a critical challenge and long-standing goal for the speech and NLP community. Despite notable progress, recent endeavors are fundamentally constrained by severe modality interference, which causes substantial knowledge degradation and compromises semantic integrity -- ultimately making full-duplex SLMs feel unnatural and unintelligent. In this paper, through an exhaustive fine-grained analysis of model optimization dynamics, we uncover the root cause of such performance degradation, revealing that modality interference arises from inherent gradient conflicts between acoustic and semantic modeling when the two modalities are forced to share a deep parameter space. Guided by this key insight, we introduce Lychee-FD, a native end-to-end full-duplex framework designed to mitigate modality interference. Importantly, we propose a hierarchical parameter separation strategy that decouples conflicting modalities in deep layers while preserving cross-modality coherence via a dedicated semantic alignment channel. Extensive experiments on multiple full-duplex benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly advances the state of the art, yielding substantial improvements in both speech intelligence (+7.4% on Spoken QA) and full-duplex interaction fluidity (+28.5% on FullDuplexBench 1.5) without compromising inference efficiency. To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first to achieve two key advances: 1) uncovering and elucidating the root cause of modality interference in full-duplex SLMs, and 2) designing an elegant hierarchical model together with a practical solution for seamless, high-performance, native intelligent full-duplex SLMs.
2607.06540.paper_summary_zh: 開發無縫、高效能、原生智能的全雙工語言模型（SLMs）仍然是語音和自然語言處理社群面臨的關鍵挑戰和長期目標。儘管取得了顯著進展，近期的努力仍然受到嚴重的模態干擾的根本限制，這導致了知識的顯著退化並妨礙了語義的完整性——最終使得全雙工SLMs感覺不自然且缺乏智能。在本文中，通過對模型優化動態的徹底細緻分析，我們揭示了這種性能退化的根本原因，顯示模態干擾源於聲學和語義建模之間的固有梯度衝突，當這兩種模態被迫共享一個深層參數空間時便會出現此問題。在這一關鍵見解的指導下，我們引入了Lychee-FD，一個旨在減輕模態干擾的原生端到端全雙工框架。重要的是，我們提出了一種層次參數分離策略，該策略在深層中解耦衝突的模態，同時通過專門的語義對齊通道保持跨模態的一致性。在多個全雙工基準上的廣泛實驗表明，我們的方法顯著推進了技術的最前沿，在語音智能（在Spoken QA上提高了7.4%）和全雙工互動流暢性（在FullDuplexBench 1.5上提高了28.5%）方面均取得了實質性改進，且不妨礙推理效率。據我們所知，這項工作是首次實現兩項關鍵進展：1）揭示並闡明全雙工SLMs中模態干擾的根本原因，以及2）設計出一個優雅的層次模型，並提供一個實用的解決方案，以實現無縫、高效能、原生智能的全雙工SLMs。
